AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings are also
archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818) 548-4013 for
program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk's Office.
Audit Reports are available for viewing by clicking here. For public comments and questions during
the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the Management Services Department at (818) 548-4844, during regular
business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JULY 28, 2022 AT 2:00 PM

1. ROLL CALL
2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the July 28, 2022 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on July 25, 2022 on

3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
   Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.
4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 28, 2022
5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  c. Annual Report to City Council
6. REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 6/30/2022 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager

  – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager

8. NEW BUSINESS

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  July 28, 2022

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM
  Present: Zareh Amirian, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon
  Absent: Rosevart Nazarian

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  A. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the July 28, 2022 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on July
  25, 2022 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 28, 2022

  Moved: Alejandro Parajon  Seconded: Edmund Khashadourian
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Zareh Amirian
  Noes: None
  Absent: Rosevart Nazarian
  Abstain: None

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A. Election of Audit Committee Chair

  There was a brief discussion on a potential delay of the Audit Committee Chair
  election to the next meeting anticipating that the newly elected City Council
  members may make their appointments to the Audit Committee. After the
  discussion, it was decided to hold the election of the Chair as originally
  scheduled. Audit Committee Member Edmund Khashadourian nominated Mr.

  1
   Zareh Amirian to continue as Chair of the Audit Committee. No other nominations
  were made.

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian Seconded: Alejandro Parajon
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Zareh Amirian
  Noes: None
  Absent: Rosevart Nazarian
  Abstain:

  B. Election of Audit Committee Secretary

  Chair Amirian thanked Ms. Antanesyan for her excellent work for the past year.
  Audit Committee Member Khashadourian nominated Ms. Antanesyan to continue
  as the Secretary to the Audit Committee for another year.

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian Seconded: Alejandro Parajon
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Zareh Amirian
  Noes: None
  Absent: Rosevart Nazarian
  Abstain: None

  C. Annual Report to City Council

  Chair Zareh Amirian read the letter titled “Audit Committee Annual Report for
  Fiscal Year 2021-22" into the record.

  Moved: Alejandro Parajon Seconded: Edmund Khashadourian
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Zareh Amirian
  Noes: None
  Absent: Rosevart Nazarian
  Abstain: None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 6/30/2022 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit
  Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on June 30, 2022.

  2
   Mr. Sameel Salim, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the Glendale
  Parking Facilities Agreement Audit – Phase II. Mr. Salim and Mr. Tad Dombroski,
  Parking Manager from Public Works answered questions from the Committee
  members.
  Mr. Sameel Salim, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the PCI
  Compliance Audit.
  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the
  Pleasant Valley Power Purchase Agreement Audit, and answered questions from
  the Committee members.
  After the audit presentations, Ms. Zhang continued presenting the Internal Audit
  activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous
  audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory
  services and answered questions from the Committee members.
  B. FY 2021-22 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2022-23 Audit
  Work Plan – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  Ms. Zhang provided a report to the Audit Committee on the FY 2022 Audit Work
  Plan Status Update and the FY 2023 Proposed Audit Work Plan and answered
  questions from the Committee members
  C. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30,
  2022 – Alwin De Leon, Finance Accounting Manager
  Mr. De Leon, Finance Accounting Manager, introduced Daphne Munoz, Partner
  at CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP, who subsequently presented the report on the Audit
  of FY ended June 30, 2022 to the Audit Committee.
7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Ms. Zhang thanked the City Manager, the Deputy City Manager and the
  executive team for their support during the risk assessment process. Ms. Zhang
  also thanked the Audit Committee members for their service for the past year.
  Chair Amirian expressed his appreciation for the efforts by both Internal Audit
  and other City staff on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of City
  operations. Mr. Amirian also congratulated the newly elected City Council
  members.
8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian  Seconded: Alejandro Parajon

  3
 Adjournment at 4:15 PM
